name: Camp CHLA Health Care Career Exploration
what_you_do: Spend 5 days at a children's hospital learning about health jobs. Hear from nurses and other staff about their work. Learn CPR and first aid. A one day Discovery Day option is also offered.
who_can_apply: High school freshmen, sophomores and juniors who live in Los Angeles County. Seniors in the class of 2027 cannot apply. You cannot apply if you went to Camp CHLA before. You must be able to come all 5 days.
pay_detail: Free. There is no charge to attend.
duration: 5 days, about 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. (Discovery Day is one day)
deadline_text: The 2027 application is open Jan 11 to Jan 15, 2027, closing at 11:59 p.m. You hear back by Mar 1, 2027. Summer 2027 sessions look like June 14 to 18 and July 26 to 30, 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online in the short January window. Write one essay of 200 to 250 words and give your and your parent's contact details. If you are picked, you upload shot records and other papers before your session.
notes: The window is only 5 days, so mark your calendar. An online info session is Dec 9, 2026 at 6:30 p.m. You need your own ride to the hospital. Use a personal email, since school email has blocked camp emails before. The page lists the 2027 session dates under Discovery Day, so confirm them. Email campchla@chla.usc.edu.
